Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

honey chipotle chicken sandwiches ✨ i will be uploading a newer version of my bun recipe because i tweaked it a bit to make them even softer!  Ingredients  - 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast - 1 1/2 cups buttermilk  - 1/3 cup pickle juice - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1 large egg - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder  - 1 1/2 tsp chipotle powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard seed powder  - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - Salt and pepper to taste  Dredge - 1 1/2 cups all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder - 1 tsp smoked paprika - 1 tsp chipotle powder - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - 1 sazon packet (optional) - 1/2 tsp mustard powder - Salt and pepper to taste  - Drizzle of marinade  Honey chipotle sauce - 1/2 cup honey - 3 tbsp chipotle peppers, blended - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 tsp apple cider vinegar  - 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1/4 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste Assembly - Brioche buns - Pickles - Ranch Instructions  - Cut/pound chicken into even sandwich-sized pieces and add to a large bowl. - Add butter milk, seasonings, 1 egg, pickle juice, hot sauce, and mix until well combined. Refrigerate for 3 hours minimum or overnight for best results. - Combine all dredge ingredients. Drizzle a little of the marinade into the flour and toss with spoon create those crispy, craggy pieces. - Remove chicken from the marinade and coat well in the dredge. Dip it back into the marinade, then into the dredge again, pressing the flour mixture firmly onto the chicken. Let the double-battered chicken rest for 10–12 minutes so the coating sticks. - Heat frying oil to 350°F. Fry chicken in batches until deeply golden and crispy and the center reaches 165°F. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. - For the honey chipotle sauce, add honey, blended chipotle peppers, butter, apple cider vinegar, garlic powder, smoked paprika and salt to a saucepan. Heat on low for 2–3 minutes, stirring until smooth and glossy. - Brush or drizzle the warm honey chipotle sauce over the freshly fried chicken. - Toast your brioche buns, add ranch, pickles, crispy honey chipotle chicken, and serve immediately.  • • • #recipe #recipeideas #chickenrecipe #sandwich

If there is one meal that belongs on your fall dinner table, it’s a cozy pot roast. Slow cooked until tender, served over creamy mashed potatoes and finished with a rich broth. It’s the ultimate comfort meal for fall 🍂 Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio 🤎  Beef pot roast Ingredients: 	⁃	2-3 lb chuck roast 	⁃	1 medium white onion, sliced 	⁃	3 celery stalks, diced 	⁃	3 large carrots, sliced  	⁃	Bite size potatoes 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Rosemary  	⁃	Thyme 	⁃	2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	⁃	3 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	2 Au jus gravy packets 	⁃	6 cups beef bone broth 	⁃	3 tbsp unsalted butter 	⁃	2 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	2 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	Salt to taste Instructions: Wash and prep all of your vegetables. Peel and dice the carrots, slice the onion, mince the garlic, and dice the celery. Season the chuck roast to your liking. I used onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Make sure to season all sides of the roast. Add oil to a Dutch oven and sear the roast on all sides for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove the roast from the pot and set aside. Add the celery and onion to the pot and cook over medium heat until the onion has caramelized. Add the minced garlic last to prevent it from burning. Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and gravy packets. Add ½ cup of beef broth to deglaze the pot, then pour in the remaining broth. Add the seasonings and taste to make sure everything is seasoned to your liking. Add the roast back to the pot, along with the carrots, potatoes, butter, and a bunch of rosemary and thyme tied together with butcher’s twine. Cover and place in a 350°F oven for 3 hours. About 30 minutes before the roast is finished, prepare the mashed potatoes. To assemble, add a bed of mashed potatoes to a plate, then top with the roast, potatoes, and carrots. Finish with some of the broth and fresh or dried parsley. Enjoy! 🤎 #fall #fallrecipes #potroast #cozyvibes #fallvibes

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Arayes 🥙 This is one of the best Mediterranean meals you can easily make at home in about 30 minutes. Crispy pita stuffed with seasoned beef, cooked until golden, and finished with a creamy garlic sauce. If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money. Follow for more weeknight staples. Ingredients Meat Mixture • 1 lb ground beef (85/15) • 1 small yellow onion, grated and squeezed dry • 5 garlic cloves, finely grated • 1 grated jalapeño • 2 tbsp tomato paste • ⅓ cup parsley, finely chopped • ¼ cup cilantro, finely chopped • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tbsp ice water • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp cumin • 2 tsp paprika • 1 tsp allspice • 1 tsp coriander • 1 tsp garlic powder • ¼ tsp cinnamon Other • 4 pitas, cut in half Garlic Tahini Yogurt Sauce • ¾ cup Greek yogurt • ¼ cup tahini • 3 garlic cloves, finely grated • Juice of ½ lemon • 1 tbsp olive oil • ½ tsp salt • ¼ tsp cumin • 2 tbsp parsley, finely chopped • 2 tbsp cilantro, finely chopped Instructions 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. In a large bowl, mix together the beef, grated onion, garlic, jalapeño, tomato paste, parsley, cilantro, olive oil, ice water, and spices until fully combined and slightly sticky. 3. Cut the pitas in half and gently open each pocket (heat the pitas in the microwave for a few seconds first to make them easier to open). Spread a thin layer of the meat mixture inside each pita, then brush the outside generously with olive oil. 4. Heat a pan over medium heat. Cook the arayes meat side down first for 1–2 minutes until charred, then flip and cook each pita side until golden and crispy. 5. Finish in the oven for 15 minutes, or until the meat reaches 155°F internally. 6. While the arayes cook, mix together all sauce ingredients until smooth. 7. Brush the hot arayes with olive oil mixed with minced garlic and parsley, then serve with the dipping sauce. #easydinners #arayes #pita

Ingredients  - 250g all-purpose flour (2 cups) - 110g dark brown sugar (1/2 cup) - 105g granulated sugar (1/2 cup) - 60ml buttermilk or milk (1/4 cup) - 113g unsalted butter, melted (1/2 cup, 1 stick) - 12oz pumpkin puree  - 6g baking powder (1 tsp) - 6g baking soda (1 tsp) - 2 eggs - 1 tsp vanilla extract  - 2 tsp cinnamon  - 1 tsp pumpkin spice  - 1/2 tsp ground ginger  - 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg  - 1/2 tsp salt Crumble - 115g all-purpose flour (1/2 cup + 1 tbsp) - 55g granulated sugar (1/4 cup) - 40g brown sugar (3 tbsp) - 58g unsalted butter, melted (1/4 cup) - 1/2 tsp cinnamon  - 1/4 tsp all spice  - 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg  Cinnamon mixture - 55g sugar (1/4 cup) - 58g unsalted butter, melted (1/4 cup) - 1 tsp cinnamon  Icing - 50g powder sugar (1/3 cup + 2 tbsp) - 1/2 tsp pumpkin spice  - 1/2 tsp cinnamon - 1 tbsp milk  Instructions  - Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C). Grease and line a 1.5 pound loaf pan with parchment paper. Crumble  - In a small bowl, combine flour, brown sugar, granulated sugar, allspice, nutmeg and cinnamon. - Add melted butter and mix it into a crumbly mixture. - Place in the fridge while preparing the batter (this keeps it from melting too fast). Dry ingredients  - In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Set aside. Wet ingredients  - In a large bowl, whisk pumpkin puree, melted butter, sugar, eggs, vanilla, and buttermilk  until smooth.  - To wet ingredients qdd spices (cinnamon, nutmeg, pumpkin spice, and ginger.) Then add flour mixture to the wet mixture. - Gently fold dry ingredients into wet mixture until just combined. Do not overmix. - Pour half batter into prepared loaf pan. Add cinnamon butter mixture spread evenly and add the remaining batter.  - Evenly sprinkle the crumble topping over the batter. - Bake for 80-90 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean (a few moist crumbs are okay). - If the crumble starts to brown too quickly, tent loosely with foil halfway through. - Let bread cool in pan for 15 minutes, then lift out and place on a wire rack. - Once bread cool  warm add icing drizzle.  • • • #fallrecipes #baking #pumpkinseason #bakingrecipe #Recipe

Recipe Name Honey Garlic Glazed Roasted Pork Shoulder Ingredients 1. Boneless pork shoulder roast – 4 lb 2. Olive oil – 2 tbsp 3. Salt – 2 tsp 4. Black pepper – 1 tsp 5. Smoked paprika – 2 tsp 6. Garlic powder – 1 tsp 7. Onion powder – 1 tsp 8. Dried thyme – 1 tsp 9. Fresh rosemary – 3 sprigs 10. Garlic cloves – 6 cloves, minced 11. Honey – 1/3 cup 12. Brown sugar – 1/4 cup 13. Dijon mustard – 2 tbsp 14. Apple cider vinegar – 1 tbsp 15. Soy sauce – 2 tbsp 16. Chicken broth – 1 cup 17. Butter – 2 tbsp Recipe 1. Remove the pork shoulder from the refrigerator and allow it to rest at room temperature for 30 minutes before cooking. 2. Preheat the oven to 325°F and line a deep roasting pan with heavy-duty aluminum foil. 3. Pat the pork completely dry with paper towels, then use a sharp knife to score the fat layer in a deep diamond pattern without cutting too far into the meat. 4. Rub the entire roast with olive oil, making sure the oil reaches inside the scored sections. 5. Combine the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, and dried thyme, then rub the seasoning mixture generously over the entire pork roast. 6. Place the seasoned pork into the foil-lined roasting pan and scatter the fresh rosemary around the meat. 7. Pour the chicken broth into the bottom of the pan, keeping the liquid away from the top of the seasoned roast. 8. Cover the pan loosely with foil and roast for about 2 1/2 hours, allowing the pork to become tender and deeply flavorful. 9. While the pork roasts, combine the minced garlic, honey, brown sugar, Dijon mustard, apple cider vinegar, soy sauce, and butter in a small saucepan over medium-low heat. 10. Simmer the glaze for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring frequently, until the sugar dissolves and the sauce becomes glossy and slightly thickened. 11. Remove the foil from the roasting pan and generously brush the pork with half of the honey garlic glaze, allowing it to settle into the diamond cuts. 12. Increase the oven temperature to 400°F and roast uncovered for another 25 to 35 minutes, brushing with additional glaze every 10 minutes until the exterior becomes dark, caramelized, and beautifully lacquered. 13. Check that the thickest part of the pork reaches at least 195°F for a tender, pull-apart texture, then remove it from the oven. 14. Let the roast rest for 15 to 20 minutes so the juices redistribute, then garnish with fresh rosemary and spoon the remaining warm glaze over the top. 15. Slice the pork into thick portions and serve with roasted potatoes, vegetables, or a fresh salad. Follow for more delicious recipes and amazing food ideas!

Classic Patty Melt Recipe Ingredients 1 lb 450 g ground beef (80/20 for best flavor) 4 slices rye bread 4 slices Swiss cheese 1 medium onion thinly sliced 2 tablespoons butter plus more for bread ½ teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon black pepper ½ teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce 1 tablespoon oil Instructions Caramelize the onions Heat oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add sliced onions and cook slowly, stirring often, until soft, golden, and sweet (about 8–10 minutes). Remove from pan and set aside. Form the patties Divide beef into 2 thin oval patties shaped to match bread size. Season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and Worcestershire sauce. Cook the burgers In the same skillet, cook patties over medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes per side until fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Assemble the melts Butter one side of each bread slice. On the unbuttered side, layer: Swiss cheese Beef patty Caramelized onions Another slice of Swiss cheese Top with another slice of bread (buttered side facing out). Grill to perfection Place sandwiches in the skillet over medium heat. Cook 3–4 minutes per side, pressing gently, until bread is golden and cheese is fully melted.
